subject: The splash window during startup: the brand mark, 'Simulacra', the tagline 'A local-first dialectic simulator', Mnemo reading beside the progress line, a stage label (on the demo profile it is already 'Ready' when the capture is taken; 'Loading networks…' or 'Warming up…' on a slower start), and 'Version 0.2.0' at the bottom.
